chunks: And in the narration of Al-Sakūnī, with his chain of transmission, he said: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said:
"I'tikaf for ten days in the month of Ramadan is equal to two hajj and two 'umrahs."

key_terms.اعْتِكَافُ: spiritual retreat in devotion, usually in a mosque
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan, the sacred month of fasting
key_terms.يَعْدِلُ: is equivalent in reward or worth

ai.seo_question: What is the reward of performing i'tikaf for ten days in Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith states the immense reward of performing i'tikaf for ten days in the month of Ramadan. It presents this devotional retreat as equal in reward to two hajj and two 'umrahs, highlighting the great merit of worship in Ramadan.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2101 - In a narration from Al-Sakuni, with his chain of transmission, it is reported that the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said:
"Performing i'tikaf for ten days in the Month of Ramadan is equivalent to two Hajj and two Umrah."
